decision_rule: Every required gate must pass for a group. A partial source or item-rights analogue contributes zero sufficient fields.

field_decisions.next_discriminator: An R7 vocabulary owner or formally delegated taxonomy custodian must sign closed_world=true over all seven target profiles.
field_decisions.reason: Provider indexes are open-world; absence is frozen as CANNOT_CHECK and no provider asserts that seven R7 target profiles are exhaustive.

field_decisions.next_discriminator: Owner-approved coordinate definitions for every target, with overlap and disjointness rules.
field_decisions.reason: Retraction, correction/erratum, and expression-of-concern metadata describe record or link status, not the closed scientific-process coordinates required for each R7 target.
field_decisions.required_source: owner-approved target algebra retaining or superseding the public anchor

field_decisions.next_discriminator: Owner-approved postpublication coordinate or explicit NONE for every target.
field_decisions.reason: Exact provider tokens identify postpublication relation classes, but they do not bind a coordinate to each of the seven R7 decisions, including explicit NONE values.

field_decisions.next_discriminator: Owner-approved exhaustive licensed-operation set for every target.
field_decisions.reason: Observed relation types show that a notice or link exists; they do not specify the exhaustive operations licensed for each R7 target.

field_decisions.next_discriminator: Owner-approved exhaustive forbidden-operation set for every target.
field_decisions.reason: No structured field enumerates forbidden R7 operations or authority-expansion witnesses.

field_decisions.next_discriminator: Owner-approved probe/decision typing plus explicit bridge table or NONE.
field_decisions.reason: PublicationType and RefType are metadata vocabularies, not a declaration that diagnostic actions are probes, decisions are terminals, or that a one-to-one bridge is NONE or explicit.
field_decisions.required_source: owner-approved explicit bridge table or explicit NONE

field_decisions.next_discriminator: Joint R7-vocabulary-owner and host-authority approval of per-target recommendation authority.
field_decisions.reason: No provider-native field grants semantic recommendation authority for any R7 target.

field_decisions.next_discriminator: Host-authority owner must assign NONE, EXTERNAL_OWNER_ONLY, or SYSTEM per target.
field_decisions.reason: A notice relationship records a publication event; it does not authorize Orion to execute, adopt, promote, or merge a postpublication action.

field_decisions.next_discriminator: Owner-approved terminal for every non-success condition.
field_decisions.reason: Provider records contain no fail-closed R7 terminal mapping for abstention, error, timeout, malformed, or unsupported inputs.

field_decisions.next_discriminator: Target-corpus rights holder or authorised licensor must publish the completed algebra with exact SPDX licence and licence-text digest.
field_decisions.reason: The inherited pool has exact allowlisted article licences and the Retraction Watch metadata snapshot is CC0, but item/source rights do not supply a public archive, SPDX licence, and licence-text digest for the target algebra itself.
field_decisions.required_source: licence text controlled by the applicable rights holder

field_decisions.next_discriminator: Verify owner identity, delegation, artifact digest, signature scheme/key/signature, and timestamp.
field_decisions.reason: Provider vocabulary publication and item metadata do not constitute a signed R7-owner ratification bundle over the completed algebra.
field_decisions.required_source: content-addressed signature bundle over the completed algebra

field_decisions.next_discriminator: A reviewer with no algebra authorship or case-outcome custody must issue a content-addressed CONFORMANT review.
field_decisions.reason: Europe PMC and PubMed agreement is not independent semantic review: both expose closely related indexed source metadata and neither reviews the proposed R7 algebra.
